Implementierungsanforderung

Implementiere die Generierung vorzugsweise als einmaliges Python-Programm oder temporären In-Memory-Prozess. Ein Generator-Script darf nicht ohne separaten GO im Peak_Trade-Repo persistiert werden.

Keine volatile Generierungszeit in die kanonische Sidecar-Serialisierung aufnehmen, sofern sie Bit-Determinismus verhindern würde.

Falls Beobachtungszeit erforderlich ist, halte sie außerhalb des deterministischen Payloads oder definiere ausdrücklich einen nicht-deterministischen Envelope. Bevorzugt: deterministischer Payload ohne Timestamp.

Layer 1 — Raw byte spans

Erzeuge eine lückenlose, disjunkte, geordnete Partition der gesamten Source.

Für jedes Vorkommen mindestens:

source_sequence
byte_start
byte_end

line_end
content_hash_sha256

Identity-Regel:

OCCURRENCE_ID = deterministic function of (
    source_sha256,
    byte_start,
    byte_end
)

CONTENT_HASH_SHA256 = SHA256 des exakten Byte-Slices.

Identische Inhalte an verschiedenen Positionen bleiben verschiedene Occurrences.

Kerninvariant:

concat(
  source_bytes[span.byte_start:span.byte_end]
  for span in spans ordered by source_sequence
) == exact_original_source_bytes

Byte-Offsets sind primär. Zeilennummern sind Navigation.

Mechanical types mindestens:

FENCE_OPEN
FENCE_BODY
FENCE_CLOSE
HEADING
HORIZONTAL_RULE
TABLE_ROW

Keine Zeile darf aufgrund semantischer Unsicherheit verloren gehen. Im Zweifel mechanisch NARRATIVE_OR_OTHER.

Modelliere die bereits bewiesenen historischen Prefix-SHA-Epochen als Overlay/Partition, ohne daraus Weltzeit oder Authority abzuleiten.

Layer 2 — Classification

Classification ist Overlay, niemals Raw-Rewrite.

Default:

                flen = len(fence)
                rest_ws = rest.strip(b" \t") == b""
                if ch == open_ch and flen >= open_len and rest_ws:
                    mech[i] = "FENCE_CLOSE"
                    body_start = line_starts[open_idx + 1]
                    body_end = line_starts[i]
                    open_b0 = line_starts[open_idx]
                    close_b1 = line_starts[i + 1]
                    body = source[body_start:body_end]
                    fence_blocks.append(

                            "overlay_id": overlay_id(
                                "fence_block", source_sha, open_b0, close_b1
                            ),
                            "overlay_kind": "fence_block",
                            "open_line": open_idx + 1,
                            "close_line": i + 1,
                            "byte_start": open_b0,
                            "byte_end": close_b1,

                            "info_string": open_info,

                            ),

                            ),
                        }
                    )
                    depth = 0
                    open_ch = None
                    closed = True

                    inner_shorter += 1
            if not closed:

                "byte_end": b1,
                "line_start": i + 1,
                "line_end": i + 1,

                if "Temporary Forensic Working Runbook — Continuation" in body:

        if mt == "HEADING" and SRC_HEAD_TEXT_RE.match(texts[i]):

        h1_spans.append(

                ),

        b0 = line_starts[start_l - 1]
        b1 = line_starts[end_l]
        region = source[b0:b1]
        computed = sha256_bytes(region)
        t3_src_spans.append(
            {
                "overlay_id": overlay_id("t3_src_span", source_sha, b0, b1),
                "overlay_kind": "t3_src_span",
                "source_identifier_alias": block_id,
                "t3_sequence": seq,
                "heading_line": ln,
                "heading_occurrence_id": occ_id(
                    source_sha, line_starts[ln - 1], line_starts[ln]
                ),
                "json_fence_overlay_id": fb["overlay_id"],
                "source_start_line": start_l,
                "source_end_line": end_l,
                "byte_start": b0,
                "byte_end": b1,
                "declared_source_region_sha256": region_sha,
                "computed_source_region_sha256": computed,
                "region_sha_match": region_sha == computed if region_sha else False,
                "covers_historical_prefix_only": True,
            }
        )

    if not all(prefix_covered):
        missing = prefix_covered.index(False) + 1
        raise SystemExit(f"HARD_STOP_T3_PREFIX_GAP:{missing}")

    # SRC-000001 canary
    s1 = t3_src_spans[0]
    if s1["source_identifier_alias"] != "SRC-000001":
        raise SystemExit("HARD_STOP_SRC000001_ID")
    if (
        s1["computed_source_region_sha256"]
        != "5a170245dd0f17988097f7011c5d5c1f86bbff4a999aee30ee88cad4695002ad"
    ):
        raise SystemExit("HARD_STOP_SRC000001_REGION_SHA")

    # --- append epochs ---
    append_epochs: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    prefix_ok = True
    prev_bytes = 0
    for ep in PREFIX_EPOCHS:
        n = ep["claimed_bytes"]
        if n > len(source):
            prefix_ok = False
            verified = False
            computed = ""
        else:
            computed = sha256_bytes(source[:n])
            verified = computed == ep["claimed_sha256"]
            if not verified:
                prefix_ok = False
        line_end = line_end_for_prefix(line_starts, n)
        line_end_status = "PROVEN" if line_end is not None else "UNKNOWN"
        if ep["claimed_lines"] is not None:
            if line_end != ep["claimed_lines"]:
                # keep proven byte match; line claim checked
                if line_end is None:
                    line_end_status = "BYTE_PROVEN_LINE_UNALIGNED"
                elif line_end != ep["claimed_lines"]:
                    line_end_status = "LINE_CLAIM_MISMATCH"
        append_epochs.append(
            {

                "overlay_kind": "append_epoch",

                "byte_end": n,

                "computed_prefix_sha256": computed,
                "verified": verified,
                "claimed_lines": ep["claimed_lines"],
                "computed_line_end_inclusive": line_end,
                "line_end_status": line_end_status,
                "world_time_derived": False,
                "authority_derived": False,
                "preceding_prefix_bytes": prev_bytes,
            }
        )
        prev_bytes = n
    if not prefix_ok:
        raise SystemExit("HARD_STOP_PREFIX_SHA_CHAIN_VERIFIED_FALSE")

    # --- wrappers: instances vs mentions ---
    wrapper_instances: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    wrapper_mentions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    forensic_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    stack: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def is_instance_wrapper_line(i: int) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
        """Return (role, token, label) for instance lines only."""
        t = texts[i]
        if mech[i] == "FENCE_BODY":
            return None
        if t in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END:
            return ("BEGIN", t, t)
        if t in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END.values():
            return ("END", t, t)
        m = BEGIN_PLAIN_RE.match(t)
        if m:
            return ("BEGIN", m.group(1), "")
        m = END_PLAIN_RE.match(t)
        if m:
            return ("END", m.group(1), "")
        m = BEGIN_ATX_RE.match(t)
        if m:
            return ("BEGIN", m.group(3), (m.group(4) or "").strip())
        m = END_ATX_RE.match(t)
        if m:
            return ("END", m.group(3), (m.group(4) or "").strip())
        return None

    instance_lines: set[int] = set()
    for i in range(len(payloads)):
        inst = is_instance_wrapper_line(i)
        if inst is None:
            continue
        role, token, label = inst
        instance_lines.add(i + 1)
        if role == "BEGIN":
            stack.append(
                {
                    "token": token,
                    "label": label,
                    "line": i + 1,
                    "byte_start": line_starts[i],
                    "occurrence_id": occ_id(
                        source_sha, line_starts[i], line_starts[i + 1]
                    ),
                }
            )
        else:
            expected = token.replace("END_", "BEGIN_", 1)
            if token in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END.values():
                expected = {
                    v: k for k, v in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END.items()
                }[token]
            matched = None
            if stack and (
                stack[-1]["token"] == expected
                or (
                    stack[-1]["token"].startswith("BEGIN_")
                    and token.startswith("END_")
                    and stack[-1]["token"][6:] == token[4:]
                    and (not label or stack[-1]["label"] == label)
                )
            ):
                matched = stack.pop()
            if matched is None:
                continue
            b0 = matched["byte_start"]
            b1 = line_starts[i + 1]
            kind = "FORENSIC_RECORD" if "FORENSIC_RECORD" in token else "VERBATIM"
            if token in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END or token in WRAPPER_BEGIN_END.values():
                kind = "TSV_COMPACT_WRAPPER"
            rec = {
                "overlay_id": overlay_id("wrapper_pair", source_sha, b0, b1),
                "overlay_kind": "wrapper_pair",
                "instance_vs_mention": "instance",
                "wrapper_family": kind,
                "begin_token": matched["token"],
                "end_token": token,
                "label": matched["label"] or label,
                "begin_line": matched["line"],
                "end_line": i + 1,
                "byte_start": b0,
                "byte_end": b1,
                "begin_occurrence_id": matched["occurrence_id"],
                "end_occurrence_id": occ_id(
                    source_sha, line_starts[i], line_starts[i + 1]
                ),
                "nested_unclosed_begin_count": len(stack),
                "source_identifier_alias": matched["label"] or matched["token"],
            }
            wrapper_instances.append(rec)
            if kind == "FORENSIC_RECORD":
                binds = None
                if "LOSSLESS_STRUCTURE_MODEL_REPORT_PRESERVATION" in (
                    matched["label"] or ""
                ):
                    binds = EMBEDDED_PRIOR_REPORT_BOUND_SHA256
                forensic_records.append(
                    {
                        "overlay_id": overlay_id(
                            "forensic_record", source_sha, b0, b1
                        ),
                        "overlay_kind": "forensic_record",
                        "wrapper_pair_overlay_id": rec["overlay_id"],
                        "record_name_alias": matched["label"],
                        "begin_line": matched["line"],
                        "end_line": i + 1,
                        "byte_start": b0,
                        "byte_end": b1,
                        "binds_blob_sha256": binds,
                        "binds_blob_sha256_matches_current": (
                            binds == source_sha if binds else False

                        "target_authority": "NONE",

    mention_needles = (
        "BEGIN_VERBATIM",
        "END_VERBATIM",
        "BEGIN_FORENSIC_RECORD",
        "END_FORENSIC_RECORD",
        "T4_CANON_COMPACT_TSV_BEGIN",
        "T4_CANON_COMPACT_TSV_END",
        "T5_COMPACT_TSV_BEGIN",
        "T5_COMPACT_TSV_END",
    )
    for i, t in enumerate(texts):
        if (i + 1) in instance_lines:
            continue
        if any(n in t for n in mention_needles):
            b0 = line_starts[i]
            b1 = line_starts[i + 1]
            wrapper_mentions.append(
                {
                    "overlay_id": overlay_id("wrapper_mention", source_sha, b0, b1),
                    "overlay_kind": "wrapper_mention",
                    "instance_vs_mention": "mention",
                    "line": i + 1,
                    "byte_start": b0,
                    "byte_end": b1,
                    "occurrence_id": occ_id(source_sha, b0, b1),

    # --- T4 REL / T5 CLS ---
    t4_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    t5_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    t4_begin = next(
        (i for i, t in enumerate(texts) if t == "T4_CANON_COMPACT_TSV_BEGIN"), None
    )
    t4_end = next(
        (i for i, t in enumerate(texts) if t == "T4_CANON_COMPACT_TSV_END"), None
    )
    t5_begin = next(
        (i for i, t in enumerate(texts) if t == "T5_COMPACT_TSV_BEGIN"), None

    t5_end = next(
        (i for i, t in enumerate(texts) if t == "T5_COMPACT_TSV_END"), None
    )

        raise SystemExit("HARD_STOP_T4_T5_MARKERS")

    for i in range(t4_begin + 1, t4_end):
        t = texts[i]
        if not REL_ROW_RE.match(t):
            continue
        parts = t.split("|")
        b0 = line_starts[i]
        b1 = line_starts[i + 1]
        rel_id = parts[0]

        t4_rows.append(

                "declared_relation_type": rel_type,

    t5_group: dict[tuple[str, str], list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    for i in range(t5_begin + 1, t5_end):
        t = texts[i]
        if not CLS_ROW_RE.match(t):

        parts = split_unescaped_pipe(t)
        b0 = line_starts[i]

        cls_id = parts[0]
        src_id = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
        src_line = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
        label = parts[5] if len(parts) > 5 else ""
        content_class = T5_LABEL_TO_CONTENT_CLASS.get(label, "unclassified")
        row_index = len(t5_rows)
        t5_rows.append(
            {
                "overlay_id": overlay_id("t5_cls_row", source_sha, b0, b1),
                "overlay_kind": "t5_cls_row",
                "source_identifier_alias": cls_id,
                "line": i + 1,
                "byte_start": b0,
                "byte_end": b1,
                "occurrence_id": occ_id(source_sha, b0, b1),
                "src_alias": src_id,

                "t5_label_verbatim": label,

    multilabel_groups = []
    for (src_id, src_line), idxs in t5_group.items():
        labels = [t5_rows[j]["t5_label_verbatim"] for j in idxs]
        unique_labels = []
        for lab in labels:
            if lab not in unique_labels:
                unique_labels.append(lab)
        if len(unique_labels) > 1 or len(idxs) > 1 and len(unique_labels) > 1:
            pass
        if len(unique_labels) > 1:
            first = t5_rows[idxs[0]]
            last = t5_rows[idxs[-1]]
            multilabel_groups.append(
                {
                    "overlay_id": overlay_id(
                        "t5_multilabel",
                        source_sha,
                        first["byte_start"],
                        last["byte_end"],
                    ),
                    "src_alias": src_id,
                    "classified_source_line": (
                        int(src_line) if src_line.isdigit() else src_line
                    ),
                    "labels_in_source_order": unique_labels,
                    "cls_aliases": [t5_rows[j]["source_identifier_alias"] for j in idxs],
                    "row_count": len(idxs),
                    "collapsed": False,
                }
            )

    if len(t4_rows) != 7175:
        raise SystemExit(f"HARD_STOP_T4_COUNT:{len(t4_rows)}")
    if len(t5_rows) != 3867:
        raise SystemExit(f"HARD_STOP_T5_COUNT:{len(t5_rows)}")
    if len(multilabel_groups) != 365:
        raise SystemExit(f"HARD_STOP_T5_MULTILABEL:{len(multilabel_groups)}")

    # --- kv packets: consecutive KEY=VALUE in fence bodies ---
    kv_packets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    run_start = None
    for i, payload in enumerate(payloads):
        is_kv = mech[i] == "FENCE_BODY" and KV_RE.match(payload) and b" " not in payload.split(b"=", 1)[0]
        if is_kv:
            if run_start is None:

        else:
            if run_start is not None:
                b0 = line_starts[run_start]
                b1 = line_starts[i]
                kv_packets.append(
                    {
                        "overlay_id": overlay_id("kv_packet", source_sha, b0, b1),
                        "overlay_kind": "kv_packet",
                        "line_start": run_start + 1,
                        "line_end": i,
                        "byte_start": b0,
                        "byte_end": b1,
                        "line_count": i - run_start,
                        "keys_not_renamed": True,
                    }
                )
                run_start = None
    if run_start is not None:
        b0 = line_starts[run_start]
        b1 = line_starts[-1]
        kv_packets.append(
            {

                "line_end": EXPECTED_LINES,

    # --- tokens ---
    def add_token(
        bucket: list[dict[str, Any]],
        line_i: int,
        start_col: int,
        end_col: int,
        token: str,
        token_class: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        line_b0 = line_starts[line_i]
        # column in unicode text vs bytes: use utf-8 of prefix
        prefix = texts[line_i][:start_col].encode("utf-8")
        tok_b = token.encode("utf-8")
        b0 = line_b0 + len(prefix)
        b1 = b0 + len(tok_b)
        # verify slice
        if source[b0:b1] != tok_b:
            # fallback: search within line bytes
            lb = payloads[line_i]
            pos = 0
            found = None
            while True:
                j = lb.find(tok_b, pos)
                if j < 0:
                    break
                found = line_b0 + j
                if found >= b0:
                    break
                pos = j + 1
            if found is None:
                return
            b0 = found
            b1 = found + len(tok_b)
            if source[b0:b1] != tok_b:
                return
        rec = {
            "overlay_id": overlay_id("token_occurrence", source_sha, b0, b1),
            "overlay_kind": "token_occurrence",
            "token_class": token_class,
            "token_verbatim": token,
            "line": line_i + 1,
            "byte_start": b0,
            "byte_end": b1,
            "occurrence_id": occ_id(source_sha, b0, b1),
            "normalized": False,
        }
        rec.update(extra)
        bucket.append(rec)

    tokens: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    sha64_masked_ranges: dict[int, list[tuple[int, int]]] = defaultdict(list)

    for i, t in enumerate(texts):
        for m in SHA64_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(1),
                "SHA_HEX_64",
                {"hash_kind": "UNKNOWN"},
            )
            sha64_masked_ranges[i].append((m.start(), m.end()))
        for m in SHA40_RE.finditer(t):
            covered = False
            for a, b in sha64_masked_ranges[i]:
                if m.start() >= a and m.end() <= b:
                    covered = True
                    break
            if covered:
                continue
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(1),
                "SHA_HEX_40",
                {"hash_kind": "UNKNOWN"},
            )
        for m in SRC_TOKEN_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "SRC_ID_TOKEN",
                {"alias_not_replaced": True},
            )
        for m in NONE_UNIQUE_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "NONE_UNIQUE",
                {},
            )
        for m in PARTIAL_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "PARTIALLY_PROVEN_WITH_OPEN_RESIDUAL",
                {},
            )
        for m in TARGET_AUTH_NONE_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "TARGET_AUTHORITY_NONE",
                {"authority_upgrade": False},
            )
        for m in PATH_DESKTOP_ABS_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "HISTORICAL_LOCATOR_STRING",
                {
                    "locator_role": "HISTORICAL_STRING",
                    "filesystem_exists_now_not_in_payload": True,
                },

        for m in PATH_DESKTOP_TILDE_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "HISTORICAL_LOCATOR_STRING",
                {"locator_role": "HISTORICAL_STRING"},
            )
        for m in PATH_DOWNLOADS_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "HISTORICAL_LOCATOR_STRING",
                {"locator_role": "HISTORICAL_STRING"},
            )
        for m in PATH_DOCUMENTS_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "HISTORICAL_LOCATOR_STRING",
                {"locator_role": "HISTORICAL_STRING"},
            )
        for m in U_TOKEN_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(1),
                "UNRESOLVED_BOUNDARY_ID",
                {"unresolved": True, "adjudicated_as_unresolved": True},
            )
        for m in Z2_TOKEN_RE.finditer(t):
            extra = {"imported_as_target_resolution": False}
            if m.group(1) == "Z2CF":
                extra["repo_z2cf_imported_as_resolution"] = False
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(1),
                "POINTER_TOKEN",
                extra,

        for m in PR_TOKEN_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(

                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "PR_TOKEN",
                {},
            )
        for m in SECTION_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "SECTION_REF",
                {},
            )
        for m in CURRENT_KEY_RE.finditer(t):
            add_token(
                tokens,
                i,
                m.start(),
                m.end(),
                m.group(0),
                "CURRENT_STAR_ASSIGNMENT",
                {
                    "currentness_upgrade": False,
                    "temporal_status": "currentness_unknown",
                },
            )

    # --- layer 2 sparse classifications ---
    classifications: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        occ: str,
        content_class: str,
        epistemic: str,
        extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        d = {
            "occurrence_id": occ,

            "authority_status": "NONE",

    for h in h1_spans:
        classifications.append(
            class_rec(
                h["heading_occurrence_id"],
                "navigation_index",
                "STRUCTURAL_INFERENCE",
                {"overlay_ref": h["overlay_id"]},
            )
        )
    for s in t3_src_spans:
        classifications.append(
            class_rec(

                {

    # pointer conflict heading
    for i, t in enumerate(texts):

        ):
            classifications.append(
                class_rec(
                    occ_id(source_sha, line_starts[i], line_starts[i + 1]),

                    {
                        "adjudication_status": "disputed",

    for fr in forensic_records:

                class_rec(
                    occ_id(source_sha, fr["byte_start"], line_starts[fr["begin_line"]]),

                    {

def atomic_write(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.parent / f".{path.name}.tmp.{os.getpid()}"
    fd = os.open(str(tmp), os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o644)
    try:
        written = 0
        view = memoryview(data)
        while written < len(data):
            written += os.write(fd, view[written : written + 1024 * 1024])
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)
    os.replace(str(tmp), str(path))
